records.jp: 愛央、少し……いいかしら？
records.en_original: Ao... Is now a good time?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... Is now a good time?
records.en: Ao... Is now a good time?

records.jp: いいよ！<CR>どうしたの？
records.en_original: Sure! What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure! What's up?
records.en: Sure!<CR>What's wrong?

records.jp: お菓子を作ってみたの。<CR>よかったら一緒に食べない？
records.en_original: I've made some snacks. Would you like to have some with me?
records.en_auxiliary: I've made some snacks. Would you like to have some with me?
records.en: I tried making some sweets.<CR>Would you like to eat them with me?

records.jp: ふう、ごちそうさま！<CR>おいしかったー！
records.en_original: Whew, thanks! Those were delicious!
records.en_auxiliary: Whew, thanks! Those were delicious!
records.en: Phew, thanks for the food!<CR>It was delicious!

records.jp: ふふ、よかった
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I'm glad.
records.en: Hehe, I'm glad.

records.jp: あれから陽桜莉さんの様子はどう？
records.en_original: How have things been with Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: How have things been with Hiori?
records.en: How have things been with Hiori-san?

records.jp: また話しかけてくれるようになったわ。<CR>愛央のおかげで、あまり構いすぎなくなったから
records.en_original: She's started speaking with me again. I took your advice and left some space between us.
records.en_auxiliary: She's started speaking with me again. I took your advice and left some space between us.
records.en: She's started talking to me again.<CR>Thanks to you, Ao, I stopped fussing over her so much.

records.jp: おお！　思いつきの作戦だったけど、<CR>やってみるもんだ！
records.en_original: Oh, that's great! I kinda just came up with it in the moment, but I'm glad it worked.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that's great! I kinda just came up with it in the moment, but I'm glad it worked.
records.en: Oh! It was just a spur-of-the-moment plan,<CR>but it was worth trying!

records.jp: もう、適当だったの？
records.en_original: Does that mean you weren't taking my problem seriously?
records.en_auxiliary: Does that mean you weren't taking my problem seriously?
records.en: Honestly, you were just making it up?

records.jp: いやいや、大真面目！　うん！
records.en_original: No, I was totally serious! Cross my heart!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I was totally serious! Cross my heart!
records.en: No, I was totally serious! Cross my heart!

records.jp: ふふ……
records.en_original: Hehe...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe...
records.en: Hehe...

records.jp: それにしても、もったいないなあ陽桜莉さん。<CR>こんなに優しいお姉さん、私なら離れないのに
records.en_original: Hiori sure is letting a good thing go to waste, though. I'd love a sister like you.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori sure is letting a good thing go to waste, though. I'd love a sister like you.
records.en: Still, what a waste, Hiori-san.<CR>If I had such a kind older sister, I'd never leave her side.

records.jp: ……私は、あなたが思うほどできた姉ではないわ
records.en_original: I'm not the sister that you think I am.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not the sister that you think I am.
records.en: ...I'm not as accomplished an older sister as you think.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 話したかしら。<CR>私と陽桜莉が前に仲違いしていたこと
records.en_original: Have I told you? Things used to be very different between Hiori and I.
records.en_auxiliary: Have I told you? Things used to be very different between Hiori and I.
records.en: Have I told you?<CR>Hiori and I once had a falling-out.

records.jp: ……ある時、リフレクターの力を使って、<CR>人々の想いを管理しようとしたの
records.en_original: There was a time when I used my powers as a Reflector to try and control people's emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: There was a time when I used my powers as a Reflector to try and control people's emotions.
records.en: ...At one point, I used the power of a Reflector<CR>to try to control people's feelings.

records.jp: そうすれば、みんなが……いいえ、陽桜莉が<CR>苦しまない世界になると思って
records.en_original: I thought that by doing that, people... Hiori, would be able to live in a world without suffering.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that by doing that, people... Hiori, would be able to live in a world without suffering.
records.en: I thought that would create a world where everyone... no,<CR>where Hiori would never suffer.

records.jp: けれど、あの子はそんなことは望んでいなかった。<CR>だから……私と陽桜莉は剣を向け合うことになった
records.en_original: But it wasn't what she wanted. In the end, we fought.
records.en_auxiliary: But it wasn't what she wanted. In the end, we fought.
records.en: But she did not want that.<CR>And so... Hiori and I ended up crossing swords.

records.jp: 許されないことをしたわ
records.en_original: What I did was unforgivable.
records.en_auxiliary: What I did was unforgivable.
records.en: What I did was unforgivable.

records.jp: そ、そんなことが……
records.en_original: That's terrible...
records.en_auxiliary: That's terrible...
records.en: That's terrible...

records.jp: でも、そんな私を陽桜莉が助けてくれた。<CR>だから私は、こうしてまた陽桜莉と過ごせている
records.en_original: Even still, Hiori saved me. It's thanks to her that I can be with her again.
records.en_auxiliary: Even still, Hiori saved me. It's thanks to her that I can be with her again.
records.en: But Hiori saved even someone like me.<CR>That is why I can spend time with Hiori again like this.

records.jp: ……もしかして、美弦さんが言ってた<CR>「報いたい」って……
records.en_original: Is that what you meant when you said you wanted to make it up to Hiori then?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that what you meant when you said you wanted to make it up to Hiori then?
records.en: ...Mio-san, when you said<CR>you wanted to 'repay' her...

records.jp: そう……あの時陽桜莉からもらった想いに報いたい
records.en_original: Indeed. I must repay Hiori for returning my emotions to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. I must repay Hiori for returning my emotions to me.
records.en: Yes... I want to repay the feelings Hiori gave me then.

records.jp: ……なんてことを言いながら、<CR>その実私が陽桜莉から離れられなかっただけなのかも
records.en_original: ...Though the truth is likely that I simply cannot bring myself to let her go.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Though the truth is likely that I simply cannot bring myself to let her go.
records.en: ...Though while I say that,<CR>perhaps the truth is simply that I could not separate myself from Hiori.

records.jp: 美弦さん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...
records.en: Mio-san...

records.jp: ……確かに、美弦さんはとんでもないことを<CR>してしまったんだと思う
records.en_original: It's true that you did something bad.
records.en_auxiliary: It's true that you did something bad.
records.en: ...It's true that I think you did<CR>something terrible, Mio-san.

records.jp: でも、やっぱり私には美弦さんが優しいお姉さんに<CR>見えるよ
records.en_original: Still, I think you're a very kind person.
records.en_auxiliary: Still, I think you're a very kind person.
records.en: But to me, Mio-san,<CR>you still look like a kind older sister.

records.jp: だって、全部陽桜莉さんのことを思って<CR>やったことなんだろうから
records.en_original: I mean, you did everything you did for Hiori, didn't you?
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, you did everything you did for Hiori, didn't you?
records.en: Because everything you did,<CR>you did while thinking of Hiori-san, right?

records.jp: ……そうね。でも……
records.en_original: Yes, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, but...
records.en: Yes, but...

records.jp: 間違った想いは人だって殺す
records.en_original: Misguided feelings can even drive a person to kill.
records.en_auxiliary: Misguided feelings can even drive a person to kill.
records.en: Misguided feelings can even kill people.

records.jp: 一度間違えた私は、また間違えるかもしれない。<CR>私は私を……信じられない
records.en_original: I was wrong once, and it could happen again. I can't trust myself...
records.en_auxiliary: I was wrong once, and it could happen again. I can't trust myself...
records.en: I was wrong once, so I may be wrong again.<CR>I cannot... trust myself.

records.jp: （……きっと美弦さんをそう思わせてしまうだけの<CR>過去があったんだ）
records.en_original: (Those experiences must be the reason she thinks like this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Those experiences must be the reason she thinks like this.)
records.en: (...There must be enough in Mio-san's past<CR>to make her think that way.)

records.jp: （悔しいな……その過去は、私の手の届かない<CR>ところにある）
records.en_original: (I hate this. As much as I might want to, I can't change what happened.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I hate this. As much as I might want to, I can't change what happened.)
records.en: (It's frustrating... That past lies somewhere<CR>beyond my reach.)

records.jp: （けど……それでも……）
records.en_original: (Even so...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Even so...)
records.en: (Even so...)

records.jp: ああ、そうか……
records.en_original: Ahh, I see now.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, I see now.
records.en: Ahh, I see now.

records.jp: もしかしたら私は、陽桜莉に報いたいんじゃなくて……。<CR>この罪悪感を晴らすために……
records.en_original: I've been lying to myself. My actions aren't a form of repayment, but simply a way to relieve my own guilt.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been lying to myself. My actions aren't a form of repayment, but simply a way to relieve my own guilt.
records.en: Perhaps I don't actually want to repay Hiori...<CR>Perhaps I'm doing this to clear away my guilt...

records.jp: ……愛央？
……なんて、いうか……うまく言えないけど……
records.en_original: How do I say this... This may not be the best way to put this, but...
records.en_auxiliary: How do I say this... This may not be the best way to put this, but...
records.en: ...How should I put this...? I can't say it very well, but...

records.jp: ……それでも、いいじゃん。<CR>罪悪感を晴らすためでも、さ
records.en_original: I don't think that's such a bad thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think that's such a bad thing.
records.en: ...Even then, that's okay.<CR>Even if you're doing it to ease your guilt.

records.jp: 私は、それでも美弦さんは美弦さんだと思うから……
records.en_original: No matter what, you're still you.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter what, you're still you.
records.en: Because even then, I think Mio-san is still Mio-san...

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: 私、付き合うよ。その償いに
records.en_original: And I'll stick with you, as long as you feel you need to atone.
records.en_auxiliary: And I'll stick with you, as long as you feel you need to atone.
records.en: I'll go along with you in that atonement.

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: （……この罪悪感がなくならない限り、美弦さんは<CR>きっと本当の意味で妹離れすることができない）
records.en_original: (As long as Mio has that guilt, she won't be able to separate herself from Hiori.)
records.en_auxiliary: (As long as Mio has that guilt, she won't be able to separate herself from Hiori.)
records.en: (...As long as this guilt remains, Mio-san<CR>surely cannot truly let go of her younger sister.)

records.jp: （そしてその罪悪感は、いくら陽桜莉さんや私が<CR>大丈夫だよって言ったところで晴れないんだ）
records.en_original: (But it won't go away just because Hiori or I tell her it's okay.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But it won't go away just because Hiori or I tell her it's okay.)
records.en: (And that guilt will not clear away,<CR>no matter how often Hiori-san or I tell her that it is all right.)

records.jp: （美弦さん自身が自分を許さなくちゃ。<CR>でも、それにはどうしたら……？）
records.en_original: (Mio has to forgive herself. But how...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mio has to forgive herself. But how...?)
records.en: (Mio-san has to forgive herself.<CR>But how can she do that...?)

records.jp: <CLGR>美弦<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Mio's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Mio's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Mio's<CLNR> Talents.
